Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR ACCESSORIES FOR USE 
IN SHUTTLES FOR JUTE LOOMS 



(Reaffirmed 2003) 



1. Scope — Prescribes requirements of accessories, such as offset tip, cover, cover lock, drag sorina, oln 
and bristles. 

2. Requirements 

2.1 Offset Tip — Should be either single or double shank. 

2.1.1 Material 

2.1.1.1 Single shank — Low carbon steel, 

2.1.1.2 Doi/6/es/?anA — Malleable cast iron with hardness at flat and conical portion from 110 to 
1 25 HRB. The shanks should be softer than the rest of the portion. 

2.1.2 Shape and Dimension — The dimensions of the offset tip of a typical pattern shall conform to the 
applicable requirements given in Fig. 1,

2.2 Cover 

2.2.1 Mater/a/— Hot- rolled spring steel of 17 SWG casQ hardened at both ends up to approximately 
1 cm from either end and having hardness between 40 to 50 HRC.

2.6 Pin — Pins for cover and cover lock shall be made of 8 SWG steel wire. Other pins used in the 
shuttle may be made of steel wire of fine gauge or as agreed to between the buyer ^nd the seller. 

2.7 Bristles — Shall be of nylon monofilament. 

^. Marking — Manufacturer's brand or trade-mark may be suitably marked on piece or on packet. 
3.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution.
